name: fan-in-shared-list-handle
description: A5 (docs/RELIABILITY_TASKS.md Track A): two constants fanned into ONE list[str] handle — unlike fan-out-fan-in-dag's `join` node, which uses two distinct handles as a workaround for the hydration gap where a hydration path without `propertyTypes` couldn't tell a genuine list fan-in from an invalid one (correlation analysis rejected both identically). Regression for that gap: the kernel driver's resolveNodeType-backed hydration must resolve `propertyTypes` the same way the ws-server driver's Graph.loadFromDict path always has, so this shared-handle fan-in completes identically on both surfaces instead of only on ws-server.
